$comment: Everything the sweep reads. section: research | news | trials | funding | methods | chatter | jobs | curiosity. weight 1 to 3 is how much an item from here counts before scoring. area is a fallback topic hint (cancer, mind, rare, women, curiosity, other). kind: rss, pubmed, europepmc, biorxiv, arxiv, openalex, crossref, clinicaltrials, reddit, mastodon, bluesky, youtube. disabled: true skips a source that failed from GitHub Actions (the reason is in its note). match: optional regex an item must contain. windowHours overrides the section default in config/topics.json. Add, remove or reweight freely; run 'Source test' in GitHub Actions to check a change from a datacenter address, the only test that counts.
